notes: The Reach has high ground at last. The burnt-dark cinderreach now stands taller than the ground you start on, so there is somewhere to walk toward — until now every region was flatter than the shrine's country, and travel could only take you down.

That country is genuinely steeper than it was: its steepest ground went from 27 to 43 degrees, against the 45 the wanderer can still climb. Nothing anywhere in the world became too steep to walk up, and no slope got steeper than the steepest slope that was already there.
The ground you spawn on has not moved at all. The shrine's clearing is the same terrain it was, to the millimetre.
Cover thins as the land rises, so the new high ground reads as open and exposed while the hollows keep their scrub.

Still short of the mark: the ground's surface has no mid-scale character. Close up it breaks up properly, but a whole hillside at forty metres has nothing between that grain and the shape of the hill itself — so the new slopes read as large smooth masses at exactly the distance this change asks you to look at them.
title: The Reach has high ground
